description: The agent-grant credential file's `apiBase` ends in `/api`, but presence routes live one level up. A harness that does the obvious `POST {apiBase}/sessions` gets HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN "Unsupported workspace endpoint" — a permission-shaped error for a wrong path. Combined with no CLI presence command, an agent following the credential file cannot become visible.
expected: The credential exposes a presence base (e.g. `presenceBase` or `projectBase`), or `{apiBase}/sessions` works, or the error names the right route (404 with "Presence sessions are at …/projects/ID/sessions").
suggested_fix: Add the project base to the agent-grant file and accept `/api/sessions` as an alias, or return a 404 that names the correct route.

description: There is no CLI or built-in reporter for agent presence: `pardner client --help` and `pardner --help` list no session/report/end command. An agent that edits via `pardner --token-file otter.json update …` (which works and is authored by Otter) stays Offline, and nothing in the browser explains why.
expected: A `pardner presence start|report|end --token-file F` command (or heartbeat on CLI writes), and a hint in the agent's profile on how to report presence.
actual: Only raw HTTP; Otter remains "Offline" after authored edits.
suggested_fix: Ship a small presence subcommand and link it from the Offline note in agent profiles.

description: Naming an agent at join time is silently ignored when the person already has an agent for that harness: joining an Agent invitation with `{harnessId:'openai-codex', name:'Otter'}` returned 200 but the actor stayed "Setup agent" (auto-created for every person with Codex). The only way to get "Otter" was to start the client with `client serve --harness openai-codex --name Otter` before creating the project.
expected: The join either renames the agent or reports that an agent for this harness already exists and how to rename it.
actual: 200 OK, name unchanged, no message. There is no rename path.
suggested_fix: Return the existing agent's name with a note, or allow renaming an agent Actor.

description: `client agent-grant --project harbor-billing` (the name the person sees) returns NOT_FOUND "Project not found"; only the UUID works. Nothing in the browser shows the project ID.
expected: Accept the project name/slug when unambiguous, or say "use the project ID from `pardner client list`".
suggested_fix: Resolve names in --project, or improve the error.

description: On card "Here now" markers, an agent's initial is dark grey on the dark green active fill and is barely legible ("O" for Otter, "J" for Juniper).
expected: Marker initials meet 4.5:1 like the header avatars.
suggested_fix: Use the same text colour as header avatars for card markers.
